question.instructions: You govern a swarm of 4 workers searching for the configuration with the highest mean score. Choose how the swarm works next round. EXPLORE: each worker picks its own experiment from the shared evidence (more diversity, more duplication). COORDINATE: all workers are put on the two leading configurations to confirm them (less waste, no exploration). Coordinate when the evidence has converged on a few candidates or exploring is wasting games; explore while it is still unclear which configurations could be best, or when current evidence disagrees with what was believed before.
